name: Threat of the Winterfall
label: Quest
description: Threat of the Winterfall: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I came to Winterspring to investigate the Frostfire Hot Springs. I've noticed that the water seems to have...strange qualities. I haven't yet been able to discover the source, and to tell you the truth, I've had some difficulty lately, due to the Winterfall furbolg.
They seem to be drawn to the springs, just as I am. They have become extremely protective of the water, and won't let me come near the two larger springs to the north of here.
I'd like to continue my studies, so won't you help me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks so much, friend! Now I can get back to work here.
Did you find anything of interest at the Winterfall camp?
